title: Special Executive Programme In Applied Corporate And Business Law
description: The Special Executive Program in Applied Corporate and Business Law provides the learner with an advance understanding of the laws that govern the legal structure of the organization, and the applicable UK Companies law of 2006.
longDescription: The Special Executive Programme in Applied Corporate and Business Law offers a detailed exploration of corporate law principles, legal structures of corporations, and key legal acts like the UK Companies Act 2006 and Sarbanes-Oxley Act 2002. Learners will gain practical knowledge to ensure legal compliance and corporate governance in business environments.
courseDetails: This program delves into the foundational aspects of corporate law, including the legal structure of corporations, the memorandum and articles of association, and various forms of legal entities. It covers the critical provisions of the UK Companies Act 2006 and the Sarbanes-Oxley Act 2002, with a focus on how these regulations impact corporate compliance, governance, and operations. Participants will explore legal strategies to help businesses navigate regulatory requirements and safeguard against legal risks.
